facts.label: Passivo no passado (correio)
facts.sub: Singular: was sent. Plural: were returned. Negativo: wasn’t delivered. Pergunta: Was it sent by air mail? Were any letters returned?

facts.label: Foi enviado
facts.sub: Use was sent para algo que alguém mandou. My letter was sent last week. O particípio de send é sent, não sended. Para vários, use were: The parcels were sent.

facts.label: Foi entregue
facts.sub: Use was delivered para algo que chegou ao destino. The parcel was delivered on Friday. Negativo: It wasn’t delivered. Atenção: delivered termina com o som “d”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The letter was sent” is a past passive.
“It wasn’t delivered” means it did not arrive.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The letter was sent” is a past passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The letters was lost”. → Falso (Plural: were lost.)
“It wasn’t delivered” means it did not arrive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A lost letter in Perth · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Tuesday morning in Perth. Anya waits for an answer from her aunt. She sent a letter a week ago, but nothing came back. Her friend Noah goes with her to the post office. The line of people is long. They wait for their turn at the window.

“Noah, my letter was sent last week, but it wasn’t delivered.” says Anya. “Maybe it was lost. Was it sent by air mail?” says Noah. “No, it was sent by regular mail. The stamp was too cheap.” says Anya.

pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: My letter was send last week.
My letter was sent last week.
items.why: The participle of send is sent.
In the passive, use wasn’t + participle.
Letters is plural, so use were.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → My letter was sent last week.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → The letters were lost.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → It wasn’t delivered.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → Were any letters returned?
